name: dompdf/php-svg-lib
input_api: Svg\Document::loadFile(local path), getDimensions parses SVG width and height
scope: Root SVG dimensions; full raster rendering not exercised.
family_note: phenx/php-svg-lib is a Packagist alias for this identical source release and is excluded.

name: meyfa/php-svg
input_api: SVG\SVG::fromFile(local path) returns typed SVG document and rect nodes
scope: One SVG document with two rectangle elements; no rasterization claim.
family_note: jangobrick/php-svg is a Packagist alias for this identical source release and is excluded.

name: enshrined/svg-sanitize
input_api: Sanitizer::sanitize(local SVG byte string) parses SVG/XML and applies SVG element and attribute policy
scope: Valid two-rectangle SVG accepted by SVG sanitizer; parsed output retains rect and fill attributes.
family: enshrined SVG sanitizer over libxml DOM
family_note: Its output is reparsed with PHP DOM only for observing the sanitized SVG tree; the counted input parser is the sanitizer.

name: mathiasreker/php-svg-optimizer
input_api: SvgOptimizer::withRules(Rule::MinifyColors)->optimizeFile(local path) parses SVG and normalizes fill color
scope: One SVG document with two rectangles; first fill normalized from #ff0000 to red.
family: MathiasReker native PHP SVG optimizer over libxml DOM
family_note: Uses libxml DOM for XML syntax with SVG-specific optimization rules.

name: rhukster/dom-sanitizer
input_api: DOMSanitizer(DOMSanitizer::SVG)->sanitize(local SVG bytes) applies SVG tag and attribute policy
scope: Valid two-rectangle SVG accepted with SVG-specific sanitizer profile.
family: Rhukster DOM/SVG sanitizer over libxml DOM
family_note: Shares the PHP DOM XML syntax parser with other sanitizers, but supplies its own SVG policy.

name: mediashowroom/php-svg
input_api: SVG\SVGImage::fromFile(local path) parses SVG document, dimensions, and child shapes
scope: Typed SVG document root and two direct rectangle child nodes.
family_note: Earlier PHP-SVG lineage shared with meyfa/php-svg; distinct source release and package path.

name: choowx/rasterize-svg
input_api: Svg::make(local SVG bytes)->toPng invokes pinned Node sharp renderer; decoded pixel result
scope: Rendered simple two-rectangle SVG to 2 × 1 PNG; sharp 0.35.5 is pinned by repository package-lock.json.
family_note: PHP package invokes a Node script requiring sharp; underlying SVG engine is sharp/libvips, not native PHP.

name: bitandblack/image-information
input_api: Image(new Source\File(local SVG path))->getSize invokes SVG image type reader through PECL Imagick
scope: SVG dimension reader only; PECL Imagick 3.8.1 parses via ImageMagick delegate.
family: ImageMagick SVG reader via PECL Imagick
family_note: Composer package wraps a PECL Imagick SVG reader; pinned extension source is data/php/ascii_pnm/pecl-imagick-lock.json.

name: darylldoyle/safe-svg
input_api: SafeSvg\Svg_Sanitizer::sanitize_markup(local SVG bytes) calls configured SVG sanitizer
scope: Standalone public helper replay with WordPress default option/filter behavior supplied by adapter; no full WordPress install claim.
family: enshrined SVG sanitizer over libxml DOM
family_note: WordPress package wraps the same enshrined/svg-sanitize 1.1.1 parser; not an independent engine.

name: t3g/svg-sanitize-elts7
input_api: enshrined\svgSanitize\Sanitizer::sanitize(local SVG bytes) parses SVG with TYPO3 fork policy
scope: Valid two-rectangle SVG on PHP 7.4; no full TYPO3 installation exercised.
family: enshrined SVG sanitizer over libxml DOM
family_note: Older TYPO3 fork/replacement of enshrined/svg-sanitize, sharing parser lineage and namespace.
